runs.title: cisd pb0.25 rat add 1.0
runs.question: Four untested LIT ideas (2026-10-19): scale-in after breakeven, a trend-day mode, a volatility-regime size tilt, news-release setups. LIT rule: 2026 only, pick on Jan-Jun, check on Jul-Oct; adopt only if both halves gain net $ and MFFU 50K 2-week passes under the live sizing (two_week 10 sessions then safe_eval, $1.90), 2-4 trades a week.
runs.verdict: Scale-in: after breakeven, the first 1m pullback >= 0.25R then a 1m CISD close -> add int(1.0 x micros) at the next 1m open + 1 tick (open risk never above the first entry's $ risk / 60% room / soft daily loss), stop at breakeven, moved to the add's price once the add is +1 of its own risk. Better net $ and 2-week pass in both halves; every neighbour (pullback 0.1-0.4R, add 0.75-1.5x, min risk 1-6 pts, add fills up to 2 pts worse) also better in both. The 2-week pass gain is 1 eval start per half (H2 rests on the 2026-10-13 trade); H1 2-week fails +0.9 pt (Monte Carlo +3.7). Engine option scale_in (default off). 2026 H1 (pick): 80 trades 3.12/wk (85% weeks 2+) win 32.5% PF 3.81 net $+49,205 ($8,073/mo) DD $-3,861; 2-week pass/fail 53.8/10.1 (Monte Carlo 50.8/10.7), 1 month 76.1/21.1, median sessions to pass 5.0, $171 per 2-week pass. 2026 H2 (check): 40 trades 2.56/wk (81% weeks 2+) win 35.0% PF 3.27 net $+26,015 ($7,004/mo) DD $-2,612; 2-week pass/fail 52.2/2.9 (Monte Carlo 57.1/6.3), 1 month 50.8/8.5, median sessions to pass 4.0, $176 per 2-week pass. 2021-25: no 1m bars, not tested.

LIT rule: 2026 only, pick on Jan-Jun, check on Jul-Oct; eval: 2-week pass not down and fail not up in both halves; funded: $ up and accounts lost not up; scored on live LIT and on top of t_check + scale_in + be_off.

runs.question: Owner 2026-10-28: turn the NA scalp into a scalper that pays on MFFU

params.rule: BLITZ = the noise-area momentum scalp (scalp-momentum.md na_scalp) + one filter: trade only when the PRIOR day's 09:30-16:00 range is at least 0.8 x its 14-day mean. Checks at the 1m closes of 11:00, 11:30 ... 15:30 ET: a close above the 09:30 open x (1 + sigma) buys, below open x (1 - sigma) sells (sigma = mean |close / 09:30 open - 1| at that minute over the last 14 sessions); market at the next open (+1 tick); stop 1.5 x the 14-bar ATR of 5m bars; after +1R the stop trails 1.5R behind the best price; out after 30 minutes or at 15:55; one position, max 6 a day, -3R day stop.

runs.title: HQ continuation (picked on 2026 H1) #1
runs.question: Owner 2026-10-23: a strategy that trades 2+ times a week, high-quality setups, high probability and high profit - trend continuation with structure (first pullback after a directional session leg).

rules: Session: London (02:00-05:00 leg, entries until 07:30) and NY (09:30-11:30 leg, entries until 12:00), one position at a time.
Opening structure: the session's first 30 minutes' range.
Directional leg: the session's first 5m close beyond it, leg >= 3 x the 5m ATR(14) from the session's low (high), with a candle body >= 0.8 ATR in the leg; only the first leg of the session counts.
Filters: none.
Entry zone: the first pullback into the leg's most recent 5m fair value gap within 60 minutes of the leg; below the leg origin first = no trade.
Trigger (within 30 minutes of the touch): a 5m close beyond the prior candle's high (long) / low (short); entry at the next 5m open + 1 tick.
Stop: 1 tick beyond the pullback's protected low (high) (6-80 pts, else no trade).
Target: the next liquidity pool in the trend direction (>= 1R), banked at 8R. Breakeven (entry + 1.25 pts) once +1R was reached.
Time exit: 15:55 ET. One trade a session.
Size: $800 risk up to a 20-pt stop, then 800 x 20 / stop (max 40 micros); $1.90 a micro, 1 tick slippage on market fills.

modes.normal: the LIT rule: $800 up to a 20-pt stop, then 800x20/stop, max 40 micros (then the weekly stop)
modes.fast_eval: eval speed: $800 up to a 40-pt stop, then 800x40/stop (run lit_x_fast_eval: 2-week passes H1 52% / H2 47%, but 21-27% of evals fail in 2 weeks)
modes.safe_eval: never risk more than 60% of the room between the eval balance and the trailing max-loss floor: micros capped at 0.6 x room / (stop x $2), min 1 (run lit_x_room_cap60: 1-month fails H1 25.8% -> 10.2%)
modes.eval: eval (on since 2026-10-18): $800 up to a 25-pt stop, then 800x25/stop, then never more than 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (run lit_tight_eval_800_25_room60: 2-week passes H1 37.5% / H2 29.5% vs 28.9 / 23.1, fails 3.1 / 0.0 unchanged)
modes.two_week: two-week eval (on since 2026-10-18, owner order: pass within 10 sessions): one winner passes - micros so the trade's target covers what is still needed to +$3,000, capped at 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (room_f 0.6), a full stop-out inside the $1,000 soft daily loss, 40 micros, min 1; no weekly stop; no new trade once the day reached the target; sessions counted from eval_start; no reset (owner 2026-10-18): after session 10 the eval keeps going in safe_eval (two_week_until 10, after_mode safe_eval; tools/lit_eventual.py: eventual pass ~80/77% H1/H2, median 7/5 sessions) (run lit_2wk_rec = config C: 2-week pass H1 52.9% / H2 50.7%, fail 8.4% / 2.9%, $174 / $181 per 2-week pass at $91.80; max risk ~$990 a trade, worst day ~-$1,008). Missing target / eval state: the eval mode
modes.funded: funded (after the pass; NOT on yet: needs funded_state wiring in live.py / cloud_monitor): risk 40% of the room to the floor, at most $800 (800x20/stop beyond 20 pts), target pays at most $1,500 (50% best-day payout rule), weekly stop, skip when 1 micro could reach the floor (run lit_funded_rec: lost in 6 months ~1%, ~$740-770/mo paid)

sizing.note: two_week mode ON (2026-10-18, owner order: an eval must pass within 2 weeks); eval / normal / fast_eval / safe_eval stay available; applied by the cloud monitor ledger and the PC bot (engine/sizing.py lit_qty), eval_start = the first session of the current eval (set it on every new purchase; the PC start cfg "eval_start" overrides it)
sizing.eval_mode_note: mode eval ($800 up to a 25-pt stop + 60% room cap) stays available: set mode back to "eval"
sizing.eval_prior_note: owner 2026-10-18: the Builder 50K eval was at -$100 (balance $49,900) when the bot went live; counted as one day before eval_start (needs $3,100, room $1,900)

modes.normal: the LIT rule: $800 up to a 20-pt stop, then 800x20/stop, max 40 micros (then the weekly stop)
modes.fast_eval: eval speed: $800 up to a 40-pt stop, then 800x40/stop (run lit_x_fast_eval: 2-week passes H1 52% / H2 47%, but 21-27% of evals fail in 2 weeks)
modes.safe_eval: never risk more than 60% of the room between the eval balance and the trailing max-loss floor: micros capped at 0.6 x room / (stop x $2), min 1 (run lit_x_room_cap60: 1-month fails H1 25.8% -> 10.2%)
modes.eval: eval (on since 2026-10-18): $800 up to a 25-pt stop, then 800x25/stop, then never more than 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (run lit_tight_eval_800_25_room60: 2-week passes H1 37.5% / H2 29.5% vs 28.9 / 23.1, fails 3.1 / 0.0 unchanged)
modes.two_week: two-week eval (on since 2026-10-18, owner order: pass within 10 sessions): one winner passes - micros so the trade's target covers what is still needed to +$3,000, capped at 60% of the room to the trailing max-loss floor (room_f 0.6), a full stop-out inside the $1,000 soft daily loss, 40 micros, min 1; no weekly stop; no new trade once the day reached the target; sessions counted from eval_start; no reset (owner 2026-10-18): after session 10 the eval keeps going in safe_eval (two_week_until 10, after_mode safe_eval; tools/lit_eventual.py: eventual pass ~80/77% H1/H2, median 7/5 sessions) (run lit_2wk_rec = config C: 2-week pass H1 52.9% / H2 50.7%, fail 8.4% / 2.9%, $174 / $181 per 2-week pass at $91.80; max risk ~$990 a trade, worst day ~-$1,008). runs.verdict: 50% rule (not MFFU Builder's, but Lucid's): 2021-25 20.0% of passes delayed (median 6 sessions), 7.4% turned into fails; 2026 67.7% delayed, 0.0% to fails. Tradeify's 40% rule hurts far more.

runs.title: Eval game: the payout path after funding
runs.question: How long until the first payout, the first $2,000 payout and $2,000 in the trader's pocket?
runs.verdict: Funded Builder 50K (buffer $2,100, payouts $500-2,000, 50% consistency, 80% split): first payout median 3.3 months (2026) / 7.7 months (2021-25); $2,000 in the trader's pocket median 4.4 / 5.4 months; blown before any payout 20.9% / 57.7%. Without the 50% best-day rule the first payout comes in 1.3 / 1.7 months: the rule is the binding constraint, because the profit comes in a few $3-4k days.

runs.title: Eval game: when to start the eval
runs.question: Do the cold-streak state, the previous day/week or the calendar change the eval odds at the start?
